# The Byzantine Legacy

> > A comprehensive resource documenting Byzantine civilization through its churches, monasteries, fortifications, and art from Constantinople to the provinces.

The Byzantine Legacy explores the architectural, artistic, and historical heritage of the Byzantine Empire, with detailed coverage of Constantinople's monuments, provincial cities, Mount Athos monasteries, and early Christian art. The site draws extensively on the Oxford Dictionary of Byzantium and scholarly sources to document sites across the Byzantine world from late antiquity through the Ottoman conquest.

## Key Topics

- Constantinople
- Byzantine church architecture
- Mount Athos monasteries
- Late antiquity
- Theodosius II
- Long Wall of Thrace
- Archaeological sites
- Thessaloniki
- Ottoman conquest
- Andronikos II
- Sea of Marmara and Black Sea defenses
- Early Christian art and icons
- Roman-Parthian frontier
- Alexander Kazhdan (Oxford Dictionary of Byzantium)
- Cross-in-square church design

## Constantinople and Its Defenses

- [Byzantine Constantinople](https://www.thebyzantinelegacy.com/constantinople): Byzantine capital's churches, monuments, and fortifications overview
- [Long Wall of Thrace](https://www.thebyzantinelegacy.com/anastasian-wall): 45km 6th century wall protecting Constantinople from Black Sea to Marmara
- [The 'Palace of Lausus'](https://www.thebyzantinelegacy.com/lausus-palace): 5th century Byzantine palace near Hippodrome with sculpture collection
- [Sirkeci Church](https://www.thebyzantinelegacy.com/sirkeci): Middle Byzantine church discovered in Constantinople's Sirkeci in 2000
- [Derkos](https://www.thebyzantinelegacy.com/derkos): Fortified Byzantine town by Durusu Lake in Thracian hinterland

## Mount Athos Monasteries

- [Xeropotamou Monastery at Mount Athos](https://www.thebyzantinelegacy.com/xeropotamou): Byzantine Mount Athos monastery founded under Constantine VII
- [Dionysiou Monastery at Mount Athos](https://www.thebyzantinelegacy.com/dionysiou): 14th century Mount Athos monastery dedicated to St. John the Baptist

## Byzantine Art and Icons

- [Icon of the Virgin enthroned between SS. Theodore and George](https://www.thebyzantinelegacy.com/catherine-virgin): 6th-7th century encaustic icon from St. Catherine Monastery, Sinai
- [Diptych with Rome and Constantinople](https://www.thebyzantinelegacy.com/diptych-vienna): 5th-6th century ivory diptych at Kunsthistorisches Museum Vienna
- [Missorium of Aspar](https://www.thebyzantinelegacy.com/aspar-missorium): 5th century silver consular plate of Flavius Ardabur Aspar in Florence
- [The Bawit Monastery at the Louvre Museum](https://www.thebyzantinelegacy.com/bawit-monastery): Coptic monastery of Saint Apollo with murals at Louvre collection

## Provincial Churches and Architecture

- [Church of Hagios Nikolaos Rangavas in Athens](https://www.thebyzantinelegacy.com/rangavas): 11th century cross-in-square church in Athens Plaka district
- [Church of Panagia Pantobasilissa](https://www.thebyzantinelegacy.com/pantobasilissa): Late Byzantine church with frescoes in Bithynian Trigleia
- [Church of Ss. Peter and Paul at Tarnovo](https://www.thebyzantinelegacy.com/peter-tarnovo): Medieval Bulgarian church with barrel-vaulted hall architecture

## Ancient and Byzantine Cities

- [Dura-Europos](https://www.thebyzantinelegacy.com/dura-europos): Ancient Syrian city on Euphrates with synagogue and church art
- [Perge](https://www.thebyzantinelegacy.com/perge): Byzantine city in Pamphylia, Asia Minor metropolitan see
- [Argos](https://www.thebyzantinelegacy.com/argos): Byzantine and Frankish era Peloponnese city in Argolid region
- [Neopatras (Hypate)](https://www.thebyzantinelegacy.com/ypati): Thessalian city in Spercheios Valley under Catalan and Ottoman rule
